integrity: Analytic proof supplied and finite standalone checks reproduced; literature overlap assessment is self-review only, independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact odd-grid Fourier interpolation with one moved node or a specified symmetric pair; threshold is specific to that two-site geometry. No claim of universal two-site displacement optimality, even-order extension, or floating-point stability.
title: Sharp two-defect positivity frontier for trigonometric interpolatory quadrature
